items.title_en: What Does ‘To Run The Gauntlet’ Mean? How A Form Of Corporal Punishment Became A Popular Idiom
items.title_zh: “挑战”是什么意思？体罚是如何成为流行习语的
items.summary_en: Wikimedia Commons Today, “running the gauntlet” is only used figuratively, to mean facing trials and hardships, but it used to be a brutal corporal punishment. In today’s world, the idiom “running the gauntlet” is often used to describe when someone is facing extenuating circumstances, sharp criticism, and trials and tribulations. But, before it became abstracted from its original meaning, running the gauntlet was a form of corporal punishment, used by militaries around the world. In the punishment, individuals…
items.summary_zh: 今天，“running the gauntlet”只是比喻性的使用，意思是面临考验和磨难，但它曾经是一种残酷的体罚。在当今世界，“running the gauntlet”这个成语经常被用来形容某人面临着情有可原的情况、尖锐的批评以及考验和磨难。但是，在它从其原始含义中抽象出来之前，“run the gauntlet”是世界各地军队所使用的一种体罚形式。

items.title_en: Archaeologists Exploring The Ruins Of Ancient Troy Just Found A Bone Flute From The Era Of The ‘Iliad’ And The ‘Odyssey’

items.summary_en: Turkish Ministry of Culture and Tourism For the first time in 160 years of excavations, archaeologists unearthed a musical instrument at Troy: a flute made of bone. Archaeologists excavating the ancient city of Troy in Turkey discovered a bone flute that dates back about 2,800 years. This marks the first time that a musical instrument has ever been found in the city’s 160 years’ worth of excavations. Archaeologists hope that the discovery of the flute, as well as a 4,500-year-old humanoid idol, will shed light on…

items.title_zh: 安克雷奇独有的冬季传统
items.summary_en: Winter brings out the best of Anchorage . Under a blanket of snow, the city comes alive with festivals exploring regional history, lively tributes to Indigenous culture, decades-old sled dog races, and comfort food best enjoyed with friends and family. Here, Alaska’s adventurous spirit is felt in the traditions of diverse communities and seasonal occasions that offer a little something for everyone. Whether you’re taking in the shimmering colors of the aurora borealis from a snowmobile or enjoying films by…
items.summary_zh: 冬天展现了安克雷奇最好的一面。白雪覆盖下的这座城市充满了活力，各种节日探索地区历史，向土著文化致敬，举办数十年的狗拉雪橇比赛，以及最适合与朋友和家人一起享用的舒适美食。在这里，阿拉斯加的冒险精神体现在不同社区的传统和季节性场合中，为每个人提供一些东西。无论您是从空中欣赏北极光的闪烁色彩

items.title_en: Anchorage: A City Within the Wild
items.title_zh: 安克雷奇：荒野中的城市
items.summary_en: In Anchorage , exploring nature isn’t only for a rare free day or a well-planned vacation; it’s a part of daily life, as integral to the city as its infrastructure and cultural offerings. A day here may start with a morning walk on any of the hundreds of miles of trails, continue with freshly caught salmon for lunch at a restaurant with coastal views, and end with a sunset picnic on a rocky outcropping, where the only sounds are crashing waves and the fleeting glimpses of beluga whales. Located on a coastal plain…
items.summary_zh: 在安克雷奇，探索大自然不仅是难得的自由日或精心计划的假期；它是日常生活的一部分，与城市的基础设施和文化产品一样，是城市不可或缺的一部分。在这里的一天可以从在数百英里的小径中的任何一条上散步开始，然后在一家享有海岸景色的餐厅享用新鲜捕获的鲑鱼作为午餐，最后以在岩石露头上的日落野餐结束，那里唯一的声音是海浪拍打的声音和转瞬即逝的美丽景色。

items.title_en: Where to See the World’s Creepiest Dolls and Toys
items.title_zh: 哪里可以看到世界上最令人毛骨悚然的娃娃和玩具
items.summary_en: Humans have played with dolls for thousands of years, but it was not until the 18th century, when improved manufacturing rendered them more lifelike, that they started to be seen as sinister. Doll makers pivoted to porcelain skin, glass eyes, and wigs made of human hair, creating children and babies whose uncanniness to real people made them more unnerving than lovable. Later, in the Victorian Era, “mourning dolls” became a common way to remember deceased children, wearing their clothes and even sitting atop their…
